title: 第19章 幕后人第20章 扑朔迷离
slug: 给你玉女心经没让你用双修证道
content_zh:
月儿正准备结束自己悲剧的一生，突然听到外面传来脚步声，赶紧把匕首收入怀中。
咦！我的听力好像也有进步了，竟然听到如此轻微的脚步声。
难道这也是昨晚少爷给自己带来的异变。
“吱扭”一声，门开了，晴儿闪身进来。
“月儿，少爷醒了，我们推他到院子里走走。”晴儿淡淡说道。
“嗯！”月儿慌忙从椅子上站起来，擦掉眼角的泪水。
晴儿不动声色看着月儿，这丫头刚才好像哭了呢。
要不是少爷想收服她，真恨不得上去扇两耳光。
小丫头，一会儿你最好顽抗到底，老娘我一定把你打到连你亲妈都认不出你。
两人回到黄夜的房间。
看到依旧躺在床上的黄夜，月儿怦怦乱跳的心才平稳些。
“少爷，月儿过来了。”
月儿一愣，吃惊地看向晴儿，不明白晴儿为什么说这句话。
“嗯！”
简简单单的一个字，月儿如遭五雷轰顶，这是床上传出的声音。
双腿不由地打颤，少爷怎么能回话，最不想见到的事情发生了，少爷醒了！
黄夜慢慢从床上坐起来。
“啊！少，少爷！您醒了！”月儿慌慌张张说道。
看到黄夜似笑非笑的表情，月儿一颗心差点没跳出来。
“没错，我醒了。”

月儿心中五味杂陈，少爷是什么时候醒的？他知不知道昨晚的事情？
“恭，恭喜少爷！”
黄夜点点头。
“你是谁派来的？”
月儿心里一紧。
“少，少爷，您问的什么我不明白？”
月儿故作不知的说道，只是声音已经有点发颤。
“你可知罪！”
黄夜此话一出，彻底打碎月儿心中的防线。
再也坚持不住，直接瘫坐在地上，小脸惨白惨白。
怪不得这几天一直觉得少爷怪怪的，从那天动手，就有些异常。
content_en:
Yue'er was about to end her tragic life when she suddenly heard footsteps coming from outside and quickly put the dagger into her arms.
Hey! My hearing seems to have improved, and I heard such slight footsteps.
Could this be the change that the young master brought to him last night?
With a "squeak" sound, the door opened, and Qing'er stepped in.
"Yue'er, the young master is awake. Let's push him for a walk in the yard." Qing'er said calmly.
"Yeah!" Yue'er hurriedly stood up from the chair and wiped the tears from the corners of her eyes.
Qing'er looked at Yue'er calmly, this girl seemed to have cried just now.
If the young master hadn't wanted to subdue her, he would have wanted to go up and slap her twice.
Little girl, you'd better fight to the end, I will beat you until even your own mother can't recognize you.
The two returned to Huang Ye's room.
Seeing Huang Ye still lying on the bed, Yue'er's beating heart calmed down.
"Master, Yue'er is here."
Yue'er was stunned and looked at Qing'er in surprise, not understanding why Qing'er said this.
"Yeah!"
A simple word, Yue'er felt like being struck by five thunders. This was the sound coming from the bed.
His legs were shaking uncontrollably. How could the young master reply? The last thing he wanted to see happened. The young master woke up!
Huang Ye slowly sat up from the bed.
"Ah! Young Master! You're awake!" Yue'er said in a panic.
Seeing Huang Ye's half-smiling expression, Yue'er's heart almost jumped out of her chest.
"Yes, I'm awake."
Yue'er's heart was full of mixed feelings. When did the young master wake up? Does he know what happened last night?
"Congratulations, young master!"
Huang Ye nodded.
"Who sent you?"
Yue'er's heart tightened.
"Young Master, what are you asking that I don't understand?"
Yue'er said pretending not to know, but her voice was already trembling a little.
"Do you know your guilt?"
As soon as Huang Ye said these words, Yue'er's defense was completely shattered.
Unable to hold on any longer, he collapsed directly on the ground, his face pale and pale.
No wonder I have been feeling weird about the young master these past few days. Ever since that day, there has been something strange.
